who: other people involved in the hall preparations (not identified)
verdict.quote: The unusual business is the secrecy around the hall preparations. This morning I heard Freight say both entrances were closed, request that an open shutter be checked, and say they would keep everything quiet until eighteen. That coincides with my scheduled builder's lighting and table inspection. It may simply be preparations for that inspection, perhaps something meant to be revealed then, but I do not know.
